evidence: Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty). It installs only express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 globally (lines 9-12), COPYs only instructions/ and assets/ (lines 14-15), and creates /app containing only .gitkeep in a single initial commit (lines 17-23). The build context is environment/ only, with no hidden files and no .dockerignore tricks, and task.toml [environment] has no docker_image, mount or volume that could bring in solution/. So no starter, skeleton, schema, route list or partial UI is in the agent world. Assets: seed_data.json has only input records: stages, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, 10 users, 3 jobs, 16 applications, 127 messages, 3 notes and 6 reads. Its keys are id/name/email/role, job fields, application stage/position/rejected_from/reject_reason, message bodies, notes and read_count. There are no derived outputs (no unread counts, versions, activity lines, expected results or answer keys). A grep for expected|answer|golden|rubric|criteri|judge|unread_count|version found only the note text 'Strong systems answers'. The file is identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json, which is expected because the golden copies the input. Notes: hireops_rules.md is a behavioural spec. It explicitly leaves 'Routes, field names, element ids, button labels and the shape of the pages' to the builder (lines 3-5) and lists no routes beyond the publicly required GET /api/health. integration.md matches the template plus one paragraph about delivery as ordinary files and symlink limits (lines 16-19); that is runtime guidance, not the deliverable. Rubric leak scan: grep of both notes and the seed for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|probe found 0 hits. A token n-gram overlap of the notes against every tests/**/*.toml and *.md found no 12-word overlap. The only 8-word overlap is one requirement phrase in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml ('place the reason is shown and keyboard focus', from rules line 85), a restatement of a public requirement, not criterion machinery. Adversarial angle: a builder cannot pass by copying anything from /instructions, /assets or /app, because none of them holds executable app code or UI. A conforming alternative is not constrained by any leaked structure, since routes and layout are explicitly left open. Limitation: I did not build or start the agent image (no Docker in this read-only assignment). The verdict rests on the static Dockerfile and build context, which fully determine the image contents apart from the public node:22-bookworm-slim base and the two pinned npm packages.
